238: Chapter Five. (Isaiah 1:4) "Woe, nation that sins, a people heavy of iniquity, seed of evildoers, [corrupting] children, [they have forsaken HaShem, they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they have turned the backside].". Seven degrees [are indicated in this verse]: YWD HH WH HY [one of the filled-out spellings of the Tetragram] [,] WW issued forth D HH HWY [ הוי "Woe", the first word in Isaiah 1:4], HH issued forth WW [,] DW apart [ה can be considered to be consisting of ו and ד, see above][.] Adam hid Male and Female who are DW (דו, "two"), as is written "corrupting children".

,"In the beginning (בראשית) created (ברא)" [Genesis 1:1]. בראשית is a word. ברא is a half word. Father [בראשית] and son [ברא is "the son" in Aramaic]. [partly] concealed and [partly] revealed: Upper Eden which is concealed and stored up. Lower Eden, goes out to journeys (other reading: to its journeys), and revealed is יהוה,יה,אלהים,את, אדני,אהיה. Right and Left are joined as one, "the heavens (השמים)". "and" (ואת), as is written (I Chronicles 29:11) "... and (ו) Tif'eret and (ו) Netsach...", these are joined as one. "the earth (הארץ)", as is written: (Psalms 8:2) "...how mighty is Your name in the whole world (הארץ)". (Isaiah 6:3) "the whole earth is full of His glory."

"Let there be a firmament between the waters" [Genesis 1:6], to divide between the Holy and the Holy of Holies, the Ancient One to the Small One, it is divided and cleaved. It is not itself divided the : "mouth speaking grandly" [Daniel 7:8 & 7:20].

It pulls and it is crowned with small crowns, with five kinds of water, and it is written:(Numeri 19:17) "And he will give on him living water". (Jeremiah 10:10) "He is a living God and eternal king". (Psalms 116:9) "I will walk before HaShem in the lands of the living". (I Samuel 25:29) "and the soul of my lord will be bound etc.". "And the tree of life in the middle of the garden" [Genesis 2:9]. YH (יה) , YUD (יוד), HE (הא), EHYY (אהיי) between waters and waters. Perfect waters, and waters that are not perfect. Perfect compassion, and compassion that is not perfect.

(Genesis 6:3) "And HaShem said: 'My Spirit will not dwell in Adam forever, for he too is flesh'". "And HaShem said", when He was staying with the Small One. From here (another version: "as when he said in the name of His saying") (saying) a matter which the hidden Ancient One is saying: "My Spirit will not dwell in Adam" from above. Because  with this Spirit that is blown out of the two nostrils, he extends downward.

And because of this is written (days of the world) "and his days will be one hundred and twenty years" [Genesis 6:3]. Yud Wav Dalet complete and incomplete. Yud by itself is one hundred. Two letters, two times, "one hundred and twenty years". Yud by itself when it is revealed in the Young [One], it is extended in ten thousand years. From there it is written (Psalms 139:5) "You placed upon me your palm (of the hand)".

(Genesis 6:4) "And the Nefilim were on the earth", this corresponds to what is written: "... and from there it divides and it becomes four heads." [Genesis 2:10] From the place where the Garden was separated, it is called "the Nefilim", as is written: "and from there it divides". "and they were on the earth in those days" [Genesis 6:4] and not after the time, until Joshua came, and the sons of Elohim were concealed.

until Salomo came and the daughters of Adam were totalized, this is what is written: (Ecclesiastes 2:8) "and delights.." "delights" [in the feminine plural form] is written, (and "delights" [in the masculin plural form] is not written). "...the sons of Adam" [Ecclesiastes 2:8] (another reading: "were hinted at") that were lifted from these other spirits that were not included in upper Wisdom. As is written: (I Kings 5:26) "And HaShem gave Wisdom to Salomo", and it is written (I Kings 5:11) "And he was wise above the whole of Adam", because these are not included in Adam.

"And HaShem gave Wisdom..." [I Kings 5:26)], Heh, it is above. "And he was wise..." [I Kings 5:11], as from it he became wise downwards, "these are the heroes that are from the world" [Genesis 6:4], the upper world, "people of the name" [ibidem], who are conducted by the name. What is the name? the Holy Name, wherewith [those] who are not holy are conducted below, and they are not conducted except by the Name. "People of the" obscured  "name", and not people of He Wav Yud Wav, not obscuring the obscure, but the diminution and not the diminution, "people of the"obscured "name",  from the general principle of Adam they have gone out, it is written (Psalms 49:13) "Adam will not spend the night in splendor". "Adam in splendor", in the splendor of the King, "will not spend the night ", when there is no spirit/Ruach.

Thirteen kings, war with seven. Seven kings on the earth were seen [as] victors of war. Nine who are ascending on ladders, who are swift according to their will, and there is no one whom they will wound with their hands. Five kings are standing in sudden calamity, against four they will not be able to stand.

Four kings go out towards four, they hang on them as grapes in a bunch, bound in them [are] seven swift ones who are giving testimony and are not standing in their places. A tree that is sweet dwells within, in its branches [are] captured and nesting birds. Under it a creature plays which rules over that tree with two paved paths to go, with seven sockets surrounding it, with four creatures being turned on four sides.

The serpent which runs in 370 leaps, leaping on mountains, jumping on the height, as is written (Song of Songs 2:8) "... leaping on the mountains, jumping on the heights". Its tail in its mouth, with its teeth, [it is] perforating on two sides. When it takes disfigurement it is worked into three spirits.

It is written: "And Henoch (חֲנוֹךְ) walked with God/Elohim." [Genesis 5:24]. And it is written (Proverbs 22:6): "Train (חֲנוֹךְ) the youth according to his way." "the youth", the known one. "with God/Elohim", and not with HaShem." "And he is no more" by this name, "because God/Elohim took him" [Genesis 5:24] to be called by his name.

Three courts of judgement, they are four. Four courts of judgement of above. Four below. As is written (Leviticus 19:35) "You shall not do injustice in judgement, in length, in weight and in measure". Harsh judgement. Judgement that is not harsh, judgement in balance, judgement that is not in balance. Soft judgement. (judgement) that is not even this and not that.

"And it was when HaAdam (האדם) began to become many on the surface of the earth (האדמה)..." [Genesis 6:1]. "HaAdam began to become many". This is what is written: "as also he (בשגם) etc." [Genesis 6:3], HaAdam of above. And it is written: "on the surface of the earth" [Genesis 6:1]. (Exodus 34:29) "And Moses did not know that the skin of his face radiated (קרן)", this is what is written: (Genesis 3:21) "tunics of skin".

קרן ("radiated"/"horn"), as is written (I Samuel 16:13) "And Samuel took the horn (קרן) of oil..." There is no anointing except with a horn, (Psalms 89:18) "and with your name our horn (קרן) shall be exalted". (Psalms 132:17) "there I will cause a horn (קרן) to grow for David". This is the tenth of the king. And it came from the Jubilee which is Mother, as it is written (Joshua 6:5) "And it shall be when blowing on the horn (קרן) of the Jubilee". The horn is crowned by the Jubilee [as] the tenth, [that is:] by Mother. Horn (קרן), which takes dignity (קרן) and breath [in order] to restore its breath to it.

And this is the horn of Jubilee. And Jubilee is ה (Heh). And ה is the blowing of breath to all. And all return to their place, as it is written: (Jeremiah 1:6) "Woe/אֲהָהּ Adonai/HaShem Elohim/God", when ה is visible to ה, HaShem Elohim [it] is called the full name, and it is written: (Isaiah 2:11) "and only HaShem shall be exalted on that day". (different version: When ה is returned to ה and י departs, retribution comes to the world, and if it was not for Adonai HaShem, the world would not endure and all would be destroyed, and on this is written "and [only HaShem] shall be exalted etc."'. Until here is hidden and crowned the Concealment of the King, which is the Book of Concealment. Worthy (another version: who leaves and knows) who enters and leaves, and knows its paths and its roads.
